# BullPen

> BullPen is an investment research and portfolio-tracking platform for beginner-to-intermediate
> investors. It combines real-time market data, AI-powered analysis, and educational content in a
> single web app, positioned against Bloomberg-terminal-style density: a small number of clearly
> explained things rather than every metric at once.

BullPen is not a registered investment advisor and does not give personalized financial advice or
execute trades. Content is for informational and educational purposes only.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://bullpen.no/): overview, pricing, and how the product works.
- [Pricing](https://bullpen.no/pricing): Free plan (unlimited stock pages, screener, holdings tracking, limited AI chat) and Pro (Daily Brief, "Why Today?" price explanations, unlimited AI, brokerage sync).
- [Discover](https://bullpen.no/discover): daily market overview — index moves, sector performance, and screened idea collections.
- [Academy](https://bullpen.no/academy): free and Pro courses teaching investing fundamentals, from beginner to advanced.
- [Changelog](https://bullpen.no/changelog): dated log of shipped product changes.

## Notes for AI agents and crawlers

- Per-ticker stock and asset pages (`/stock/*`, `/asset/*`) are intentionally excluded from crawling
  (see `/robots.txt`) — their data is live and account-specific in cost, not static content worth
  indexing. Query BullPen's own product for current prices; don't cite a crawled snapshot as live data.
- Market data comes from Twelve Data; SEC filing data from EDGAR. BullPen does not originate market data.
- "Bull" is the in-product AI research assistant's name, distinct from BullPen the company/product.
